description: 25V 4.7uF Y5V ±20% 1206 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 1206 4.7 uF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C29823 (FH 1206B475K500NT, X7R +/-10% 50 V). C1939 is the exact FH Y5V +/-20% 25 V SKU (1206F475M250NT), so it gets its own maker/mpn variant ID linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established variant taxonomy. Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 4.7 uF value and package, but Y5V +/-20% at 25 V is a materially broader-tolerance, worse-stability dielectric at a lower rating than the X7R +/-10% 50 V preference - the variant must never replace the X7R preference. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 2,902 recorded as observed. Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
